title: plugin.md says the coord_ tools come right after kb_feedback, but kb_monitor_status, kb_backlog, kb_querylog and kb_docs come first
goal: kb/_self/plugin.md names the place the eight coord_ tools have in tools/list when KB_COORD_TOOLS is 1: after kb_docs, before kb_backlog_write and the live-docs tools, in the order kb_mcp.py's handle() builds

run: import json,os,subprocess,sys;p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kb_mcp.py'],input=json.dumps({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':1,'method':'tools/list'})+'\n',capture_output=True,text=True,env={**os.environ,'KB_COORD_TOOLS':'1'});assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr;n=[t['name'] for t in json.loads(p.stdout)['result']['tools']];d=open('kb/_self/plugin.md',encoding='utf-8').read();i=n.index('kb_feedback');assert n[i+1]=='coord_claim' or ('right after '+chr(96)+'kb_feedback'+chr(96)) not in d,'plugin.md says the coord_ tools come right after kb_feedback; the tool after it is '+n[i+1]
